topic.angle: Shannon's thesis linking Boolean algebra to switching circuits

card.title: Logic turned out to be circuits

body.claim: In 1937 a master's thesis showed that Boolean logic can be built from electrical switches.
body.why: Claude Shannon's MIT thesis, 'A Symbolic Analysis of Relay and Switching Circuits', showed that electrical applications of Boolean algebra could construct any logical numerical relationship. A switch is on or off, like true or false, so circuits could carry out logic. It laid the theory behind digital circuits.

probes.question: Whose algebra did Shannon apply to switching circuits?
True or false: Shannon's thesis was about applying Boolean algebra to relay and switching circuits.
